sections.title: FIDELITYRESEARCH Fidelity-Research
sections.overview: Shell-integrated MC cartridge, an improved version of FR-7.It uses a unique push-pull power generation system with a magnetic circuit consisting of two magnets and four poles.In this system, power is generated at four locations, so that a sufficiently large output voltage can be obtained even with a low-impedance coil. In addition, while the general system generates a cancellation current in the power generation circuit, the FR-7f magnetic circuit can be obtained as a positive output even in the conventional cancellation current generation region. This improves the phase and crosstalk characteristics, greatly increases the electrical conversion efficiency, and improves the output power.Samarium-cobalt magnets are used as magnetic circuit materials. These magnets have superior characteristics such as high coercive force and resistance to self-demagnetization compared with ordinary alnico magnets, and retain the initial characteristics of the magnetic circuit over a long period of time.A fully air-core coil without a winding frame is used for the power generation coil, and unnecessary magnetic materials do not move in the power generation magnetic field, and distortion of the reproduced signal is fundamentally removed. The effective mass of the vibrator can also be reduced to approximately 2/3, and high-frequency mechanical impedance is reduced.The needle tip uses a unique refined contact needle with special polishing of solid 0.15mm square solid diamond.The Refined Contact Needle is a new method that combines the advantages of the line contact needle with the advantages of the elliptical needle. It is less susceptible to adverse effects (noise, etc.) from disc sleds and dust in the sound groove. It also produces very little scratch noise or surface noise, so you can enjoy sound reproduction with good clarity and no fatigue.Special aluminum alloy cantilever is used for the cantilever.This is a straight cantilever made of highly corrosion-resistant special aluminum alloy and subjected to an optimum heat-curing treatment (ceramic treatment). It is made to minimize moment of inertia and deflection during high-speed motion.By adopting a structure in which the head part of the string holder extends to the front of the damper B, the position of the supporting point is made more clear. By this, the position of the cantilever vibration supporting point is made more clear, and the change in the vibration distance of the cantilever at each frequency is minimized.In addition, the string wire that applies tension to the cantilever is made of a material with a high spring coefficient and little aging, which contributes to the improvement of the square wave characteristics.It adopts a double damper system, and by adopting a damper structure of two layers with different rubber coefficients, it effectively dumps both middle and low frequencies of vibration, making it possible to make an ideal trace over the entire reproduction frequency.In addition, the rubber coefficients of damper A and damper B are different, so that the effect of temperature on trace performance, mechanical impedance characteristics, and playback sound is totally reduced.In order to solve the problem that the coil lead wire vibrates with the cantilever, the coil lead wire is inserted between the damper A and B and press-bonded to eliminate unnecessary power generation caused by the lead wire.The head shell part is designed to completely eliminate dead space which causes parasitic vibration harmful to sound quality. A universal tone arm exclusively for light needle pressure announced when Fidelity Research was established.It is equipped with a Gyro-Stat (Gyrostat), a unique mechanism developed further from the Gyro-Gimbal type.This mechanism has a structure using four miniature bearings with high precision, and the rotation support part moves with completely uniform force in the 360  direction as seen from the arm tip, and the force required for rotation is also kept small. Precise adjustment is possible without a needle pressure meter. In addition, the needle pressure weight adopts a new mechanism that clicks and stops at every scale.By press-fitting a vinyl damping material inside the arm pipe and using special synthetic rubber for the rotation support part, resonance generated in each part of the arm is absorbed.In addition, the damping material of the rotation support part protects the bearing from external shocks and loads.Equipped with a lateral balancer.It is preset to the Stable position with the center of gravity of the arm slightly lowered in consideration of stability when tracing warped records.The head shell part is European standard 4-terminal type.The lead wire of the arm base uses a unique FR 5-terminal type connector and does not require soldering.Base attachment with anti-vibration hardening against vibration from the floor is attached.We also received a special order of 40cm arm FR-26.

This mechanism has a structure using four miniature bearings with high precision, and the rotation support part moves with completely uniform force in the 360 ° direction as seen from the arm tip, and the force required for rotation is also kept small. Therefore, the effective mass of the movable part can be kept small, and the structure is optimum for light needle pressure. In addition, since the center of gravity of the movable part of the arm is almost equal to the center of rotation axis, operation at light needle pressure is extremely stable. By using light alloy for each part, the total weight of the moving parts is limited to 170g, and the balance weight at the rear of the arm is limited to 40g. The needle pressure adjustment can be read directly from 0 to 2 grams in 0.1g steps. Precise adjustment is possible without a needle pressure meter. In addition, the needle pressure weight adopts a new mechanism that clicks and stops at every scale. By press-fitting a vinyl damping material inside the arm pipe and using special synthetic rubber for the rotation support part, resonance generated in each part of the arm is absorbed. In addition, the damping material of the rotation support part protects the bearing from external shocks and loads. Equipped with a lateral balancer. It is preset to the Stable position with the center of gravity of the arm slightly lowered in consideration of stability when tracing warped records. sections.overview:
750,000(released in 1998)  750,000(around 2001)  880,000(around 2002)  930,000(around 2004)  970,000(around 2005)  1,390,000(around June 2007)

A preamplifier designed for line stage, incorporating ideas gained from the development of the Resolution Series preamplifier.It uses a unique enhanced class A circuit and does not use any overall feedback / feed-forward.A specially designed bias circuit prevents the distortion form and tone from changing after warm-up and ensures that the operating temperature is reached very quickly without the need for long warm-up periods.The circuit configuration is a full discrete configuration and uses only semiconductors that have undergone curve tracer analysis and trial listening of characteristics.The tape monitor circuit of a typical amplifier uses only a passive switch. However, since the input / output impedance and the characteristics of the input / output circuit of the equipment using the monitor loop differ from each other, the sound quality may be inconsistent and the playback sound may not be satisfactory. Therefore, the tape input / output of the FM155includes a discrete Class A buffer circuit to isolate the high-level output from the subsequent load. This provides constant sound quality and high signal quality regardless of load or source type. It also eliminates frequency non-linearity, distortion, sound compression and clogging.There is no wiring material for signal transmission inside the FM155, and the performance does not vary from unit to unit.The power level and balance control are specially designed for the FM Accor Stix and hand selected by a special machine.The transformer uses a special dual shield to prevent stray magnetic fields.DIN, IEC, and MIL standard parts are used and hand selection and hand matching are done thoroughly.The four contact ultra-precision relay manufactured in Switzerland is hermetically sealed to prevent the contacts from being affected by the surrounding environment, and the four contacts with a special coating can withstand tens of millions of switching operations.It has a fully modular design.All output circuits are protected from short circuit.The FM155uses a delay type switch ON. When the switch is ON, the signal flow diagram is sent to the output. After self-diagnosis, the control circuit starts the output when each part is in the complete state. It takes approximately 10seconds to reach the complete operating state.The FM155can be connected to any balanced or unbalanced device. The necessary cables, RCA / phono and XLR connectors are available from Precision Interface Technology.Other types of connectors, such as Fisher and Camac, are available on special order.The minimum guaranteed specifications are attached to the user'Ωs manual for each product to be shipped.

A line-stage preamplifier equipped with a unique input and symmetrical output circuit for complete symmetrical signal processing.The FM255uses a fully discrete-configuration enhanced Class A circuit with unique precision adjustment without the use of an operational amplifier or IC, and achieves an excellent CMRR (common-mode rejection ratio) of 95dB over the entire playback band.The fully balanced super-coupling output has a sensor circuit that automatically compensates for differences between balanced and unbalanced loads, so that all interfaces are 100% compensated and no rewiring or soldering is required to dominate the interface function.It uses its own fully balanced and enhanced Class A circuit for high stability and high purity signal processing, without any overall feedback or feed-forward.It uses a specially designed bias circuit to reach operating temperature very quickly without the need for long warm-up, and to minimize the change in tone after warm-up.The phase of the main output can be inverted by 180  with the phase inversion switch on the front panel.This operation is performed without any additional circuitry, and the signal does not enter the 180  phase inversion stage ; the positive and negative signal paths are identical.A tape monitor circuit using a discrete class A buffer circuit is mounted.The built-in buffer circuit enables constant sound quality and signal transmission regardless of load or source type.The built-in high-precision power supply circuit realizes excellent noise characteristics and distortion factor.The internal power supply is fully shielded and an additional supershield is added inside the transformer housing to eliminate hum, noise, magnetic and electronic interference of all kinds and conduct it to ground.No internal wiring for signal transmission is used, and variations in performance between units are eliminated.All output circuits are protected from short circuit.The chassis structure is mechanically damped to protect sensitive electronic components from inductive resonance. The chassis side panels, covers, bottom and transformer mounting are supported by special rubber and Dellin2suspension.Special shielding prevents hum, interference, and noise entering the audio signal path through relays, switches, and potentiometers.The output level control uses precise and high-resolution spread balance control and is carefully isolated by a unique enhanced class A buffer circuit.The balance control uses a unique super-wide balance control.This balance control uses a center positioning system that adjusts the knob within   1dB when the knob is rotated from the center position of   45 . This method provides an excellent resolution of 0.02dB and allows far more accurate adjustment than a conventional balance control.It uses a Swiss-made 4-contact ultra-high precision relay with hermetic seal.The four specially coated contacts can withstand tens of millions of switch-over operations, and the hermetic seal keeps the contacts unaffected by the surrounding environment, preventing degradation of overall performance and sound quality.The pin arrangement of the balanced input connector is the standard specification of #1ground, #2cold and #3hot, but it can be changed to the configuration of #1ground, #2hot and #3cold by the high-precision switch.It has a unique control / protection circuit.Delay type switch-on is adopted. No signal flows to the output when the switch is turned on. The control circuit starts the output after each part is completed by self-diagnosis. It takes about 10seconds to reach the complete operation state.It also includes sensors to protect the FM255and connected devices from excessive voltage drops that can cause malfunction, transient failure, or DC instability.Equipped with two fully balanced high-level inputs and Route 3unbalanced high-level inputs, high-precision unbalanced tape monitor loops such as buffers, and fully balanced outputs.It is a fully modular design.

This is a stereo power amplifier of the Resolution Series that has been developed over 8years.The power supply is equipped with a toroidal transformer made of steel with excellent properties and manufactured by a special method.In general, the use of multiple transformers has advantages such as low crosstalk. However, only one excellent transformer is installed to improve the characteristics by the circuit, physical layout and power supply design.As a result, by installing only one strong transformer, it is possible to play back with a margin even from a source that requires more power than a single channel such as a timpani.The power supply section uses a custom-made high-precision capacitor to supply power with extremely low impedance.FM acoustic capacitors use a technique that greatly reduces the ESR (Electrical Series Resistance) to increase ripple current capacity and achieve linearity across the frequency band.In addition, the Resolution Series has a special surge protection circuit with a soft start function to limit the rush current, which reduces the deterioration of the capacitor due to the rush current and extends its life.Low impedance is achieved by adopting the star ground method for amplifier design.In the star ground system, each amplification stage is connected to the ground point at the center. Ground modulation and power supply impedance are suppressed and interference between stages caused by ground connection is prevented.In addition, the chassis is designed to be connected only to the power ground and not to the audio ground to prevent distortion, oscillation and hum when connected to the XLR cable with a preamp connected to ground.The amplifier circuit uses a unique full discrete Class A design without overall feedback, and a discrete balanced Class A input stage provides a superior common-mode rejection of 90dB or more.The balanced input stage consists of three precisely adjusted voltage gain stages, followed by a pre-driver stage, a driver stage, and an output stage, so that each stage can operate only at the minimum operating range, preventing excessive load and maintaining high stability over long periods of time.In addition, pure class A operation is guaranteed for all stages before the driver stage, and the output stage is specially enhanced class AB operation. This circuit configuration and the use of carefully selected parts reduces dynamic and static distortion.Selected products are used for transistors.The FM Accor Stix carries out a wide range of measurements for each transistor up to a voltage of 250V and a current of 20A or more, and finds and uses transistor pairs that have exactly the same static and dynamic characteristics.The transistor chip is encased in a hermetically sealed ceramic housing with an average output semiconductor of approximately 10-20mm.246mm vs.2It is a large one with surface area.The semiconductor uses bipolar transistors, which are about 10times faster than ordinary high-quality output devices, and MOSFETs are not used to avoid compression of output current due to the integrated resistance on the chip.It is equipped with a protective system, and in the event of an error such as transient in the power line, high-frequency oscillation of connected equipment, strong RF signal, short circuit, DC offset voltage, or incomplete earth / ground, the load is immediately disconnected and turned off.This protection system does not use fuses or other non-linear components in the circuit paths, audio output lines, DC supply rails, etc., to minimize adverse effects on the audio signal.In the FM411protection system, the computer samples various circuit parameters, such as both peak and average output currents, rail voltage, output voltage, temperature, and bias, at a rate of 20sub-second per second, and compares the data with values in a practical environment.When a short circuit occurs in the output or when the average rush current becomes very large, the output voltage disappears and the rail voltage drops. In this situation, the FM411shuts off the output, flashes the power supply lamp and displays an error message. At the same time, another circuit measures the load impedance at a rate of 20times per second and automatically resets the amplifier when the short circuit disappears.In the case of DC offset, etc., when DC of 1v or more appears, the output is cut off and DC Error is displayed. After that, the measurement is continued and when DC is removed, the amplifier automatically returns.For high-frequency oscillation caused by the oscillation of the ground loop or connected equipment, we use a sensor that measures all frequencies above 20kHz instead of a general high-frequency filter. When there is a continuous high-frequency signal, the output is cut off instantly and the power supply lamp flashes to display the HFError. In this case, when the high-frequency signal is removed, it returns.In addition, it is equipped with protection mechanisms such as multi-sensor / multi-area overheat protection circuit and protection circuit for protection circuit, and has obtained very high reliability.The internal wiring is made of a special low-loss FORCELINES cable that is soldered to the contacts, and the high-current wiring is made of materials suitable for the application so that gold is not used for the contacts.Internal connections, ground connections and screws are tightened with a torque variable screwdriver to ensure that each screw is tightened to the correct torque.The rail voltage (supply voltage) connection and output connection are soldered with high precision.The front panel uses machined aluminum 900that is anodized with high precision after laser processing.In addition, resonance is analyzed in every part from manually rounded edges, special treatment to prevent objects from falling inside the amplifier, and isolated output terminals, and resonance is completely eliminated when resonance is found.In addition, the finished product is mechanically damped according to the material and method necessary to suppress acoustic resonance. The parts where such resonance is likely to occur are damped with special foam, rubber such as Delrin / 2, and other materials. This is a stereo power amplifier of the Resolution Series that has been developed over 10years.The power supply is equipped with a toroidal transformer made of steel with excellent properties and manufactured by a special method.In general, using multiple transformers has advantages such as reducing crosstalk. However, in FM711, only one excellent transformer is installed to improve the performance by the circuit, physical layout and power supply design.By installing only one powerful transformer, it is possible to play back with a margin even from a source that requires more power than a single channel such as timpani.In the FM711, a custom-made high-precision capacitor can be supplied with extremely low impedance by driving the transformer into an optimum shape.The FM acoustic capacitor reflects a technique that greatly reduces the ESR (Electrical Series Resistance), with a very high ripple current capacity resulting in linearity across the frequency band.In addition, the Resolution Series has a special surge protection circuit with a soft start function to limit the rush current, which reduces the deterioration of the capacitor due to the rush current and extends its life.The Resolution Series uses a star-ground system to reduce impedance.In the star ground method, each amplification stage is connected to the ground point at the center, and ground modulation and power supply impedance are suppressed to prevent interference between stages caused by the ground connection.If the chassis is connected to an electrical ground and XLR cable is connected to a preamp connected to ground, a ground loop will be formed, causing distortion, oscillation, hum, etc.In FM711, the chassis is only connected to the power ground, not the audio ground, eliminating this problem.The amplifier circuit features a unique full discrete Class A design, no overall feedback, and a discrete Class A balanced input stage for a superior common-mode rejection of 90dB or more.The balance input stage consists of three voltage gain stages with precisely adjusted steps, followed by a pre-driver stage, a driver stage, and an output stage. This allows each stage to operate within the optimum operating range without excessive load and enables high stability over a long period of time.The transistors are selected not only under static conditions but also under dynamic conditions.In the FM Accor Stix, a single transistor is measured over a wide range up to a voltage of 250v and a current of 20A or more, and transistors with absolutely identical transmission characteristics are used as a pair.In addition, the transistor chip is encased in a hermetically sealed ceramic housing with an average output semiconductor of approximately 10-20mm to allow for temperature variations.246mm vs.2It is a large one with surface area.FM Acoustic semiconductors are about 10times faster than ordinary high-quality output devices, and bipolar devices are used instead of MOSFETs in consideration of sound quality.In FM711, pure class A operation is guaranteed over all stages before the driver stage, and the output stage is specially enhanced class AB operation. This circuit configuration and the use of carefully selected parts reduces dynamic and static distortion.It is equipped with a protective circuit, and in the event of an error such as transient in the power line, high-frequency oscillation of the connected equipment, strong RF signal, short circuit, DC offset voltage, or incomplete earth / ground, the load is immediately disconnected and turned off.The FM711protection circuit allows the computer to sample various parameters such as peak and average output current, rail voltage, output voltage, temperature and bias at a rate of 20times per second and compare the data with the actual values. Therefore, the circuit path, audio output line, and DC supply rail can be configured without fuses or other non-linear components. Current limitation and compression are not used to reduce the negative impact on the audio signal.In FM711, when DC of 1v or more appears, the output is cut off and DC Error is displayed. If the DC is removed after the measurement is continued, the amplifier automatically returns. In addition, it is equipped with a sensor that measures all frequencies of 20khz or more. When there is a continuous high-frequency signal, the output is cut off instantly and the power lamp blinks to display HFError. When the high-frequency signal is removed, the amplifier returns.In addition, it is equipped with protection mechanisms such as multi-sensor / multi-area overheat protection circuit and protection circuit for protection circuit to improve reliability.Special low-loss FORCELINES cables are used for the internal wiring and are carefully soldered to the contacts. In addition, in order to use materials suitable for the application, gold is not used for the contacts of the high-current wiring materials.Internal connections, ground connections and screws are tightened with a torque variable screwdriver so that each screw is tightened to the correct torque.Moreover, the connection of rail voltage (supply voltage) and connection of output are made with high precision soldering.High-precision anodized machined aluminum 900is used for the front panel.We also analyze all parts such as manually rounded edges, special processing to prevent objects from falling inside the amplifier, and isolated output terminals to thoroughly eliminate resonance.Parts where resonance is likely to occur are damped with special foam, rubber such as Delrin / 2, and other materials.

sections.overview: The Chorus series small bookshelf speaker system.A 14cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.These units use poly-glass diaphragms, which have been used only in high-end models. The surface of cellulose fiber cone with excellent resolution is coated with hollow fine particles of extremely hard silica glass resin with a special adhesive. The combination of cellulose with high internal loss and light weight and a highly synthetic silica glass layer enables smoother and more accurate sound wave propagation.Butyl edge is used for the edge part.A newly designed 2.6cm inverted dome type tweeter called TPC is installed in the high range.In this TPC, the voice coil is rigidly fixed to the center of the dome to improve energy propagation while maintaining mechanical coupling between moving parts. In addition, the diaphragm is made of titanium monoblock and is damped with 5? m thick polymer. In particular, linearity in the 15kHz to 22kHz band is taken into consideration. description: Audio Database FORTE AUDIO F40H ¥ 285,000 (around 1992) Commentary This is a line-level preamplifier that has an orthodox function of amplifying a small-level signal and sending it to a power amplifier. Only two elements are actually used to amplify the signal, and the parts are carefully selected to the minimum necessary to achieve linearity by thoroughly simplifying the signal path. The front end is a pure Class A circuit with a fully matched low-noise J-FET, a monolithic FET constant-current drive that achieves high reproducibility with only partial feedback. In addition, in order to reduce interference between each signal path, a circuit topology based on a computer design is adopted, and excellent crosstalk characteristics are realized. The high current power supply is made into a separate unit in order to eliminate the influence of the power supply on the circuit. The power supply unit contains a 4200 μ F computer-grade capacitor and is designed to further regulate the smoothed DC output with a monolithic constant-voltage source. The CD input and preamp output can be balanced. With the optional phono equalizer board, analog playback is possible. sections.title: FOSTER-FOSTEX UP-103
sections.overview:
3,900(1piece, around 1972)  5,000(1piece, around 1974)  5,300(1piece, around 1976)

10cm cone type full range speaker unit of UP series aiming at natural sound with little distortion.SM (Synthetic Material) cone is used for the diaphragm.The SM cone is a composite molding cone newly developed by FOSTEX Co., Ltd. as a cone paper which also has the necessary condition as a vibration plate. In general normal cone paper, internal loss decreases greatly when rigidity is increased, and on the contrary, rigidity tends to decrease extremely when internal loss is sufficiently increased. However, in the composite molding cone, pulp material with sufficient rigidity and special material with large internal loss are used. By finishing by a special method different from the conventional cone paper molding method, strain is reduced and more ideal characteristics are realized.The center of the cone paper is equipped with a high frequency radiator, which is made of metal material molded into a dome shape with an optimum radius of curvature. This radiator operates in the frequency band of 10kHz or higher, greatly improving the directional characteristics and realizing natural high frequency reproduction.A part of UP series uses titanium material for this radiator (I didn'Ωt know which unit it was.)The voice coil uses an edgewise coil made of aluminum ribbon with a large diameter and narrow winding width.This voice coil has undergone a special heat-resistant treatment to withstand temperatures up to 230  C.The magnetic circuits use doughnut type ferrite magnets with larger magnet sizes than the conventional FE-SR series.Die-cast frame is used for the frame.

sections.title: FOSTER-FOSTEX GZ-75
sections.overview: A medium-sized speaker system designed around an edgeless woofer based on the SLE system.A 20cm cone type woofer using SLE method is mounted in the low range.In the SLE (Super Linear Long Excursion) system, the mechanical suspension (edge) is removed from the outer circumference of the cone paper, and excellent linearity is obtained. In addition, there is no valley in the mid-range characteristics caused by abnormal vibration of the edge or abnormal sound in the low range, and excellent low range reproduction is possible. In addition, a balanced double damper mechanism is adopted in which two upper and lower positions of the winding part of the voice coil are fixed, and the symmetry of the piston motion of the cone paper is enhanced.In the SLE woofer, by eliminating the edge and adopting a double damper mechanism, the stroke of the vibration system is twice that of the conventional one, thereby realizing excellent input resistance despite the 20cm aperture.The SLE system woofer unit is equipped with an acoustic low-pass filter.There is a gap of 1mm between the cone paper and the outer ring frame. If this part is replaced with an equivalent circuit, it works like a port in a bass-reflex cabinet with a resonance point at a certain frequency. The acoustic low-pass filter is designed so that the resonance frequency is below the audible frequency. Therefore, this filter has a sufficiently large attenuation characteristic in the audible frequency, the gap can be completely ignored, the sound pressure before and after the cone paper does not short-circuit through the gap, and there is no sound pressure drop.The cone paper of Woofer is made of pulp material with sufficient rigidity, and special material with large internal loss is added for composite molding, which increases internal loss while maintaining rigidity.The mid-range is equipped with a 10cm cone scoker and the high-range is equipped with a 5cm cone tweeter.The diaphragm of these units is a composite molding cone combined with a dome radiator.The enclosure is hermetically sealed.The exterior has a Eurasian cheek open pore finish.

sections.overview: A compact monitor speaker system designed as a near-field monitor.A 16cm cone type woofer with FOSTEX-original HP (Hyperbolic Paraboloidal) diaphragm is mounted in the low range.The HP diaphragm has a third order phase structure consisting of a hyperbola and paraboloid, which eliminates the natural resonance that cannot be avoided with conventional diaphragms, and realizes high-speed original sound tracking with high structural strength. The HP diaphragm also realizes wide-range playback.The diaphragm is made of wood pulp as a base material combined with various new materials such as ultra-high modulus carbon fiber and super fiber PBO. By sublimating the characteristics of wood pulp to a higher dimension, we have achieved a fusion of propagation speed close to that of titanium and internal loss equal to that of PP material.In addition to the excellent linearity achieved by the push-pull double damper, the UDR tangential edge eliminates the inverse resonance that previously occurred at the edge, making it possible to reproduce without turbidity.A 2cm soft dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.This unit uses a UFLC diaphragm to achieve flat characteristics without peaks or dips and to eliminate unique characters.Each unit has an anti-magnetic design.The enclosure is designed for use at the console top with time alignment at the listening point, with the woofer and tweeter positioned in the optimal front-to-back position to achieve ideal phase characteristics, and with sound sources concentrated to accurately reproduce orientation.In addition, 21mmMDF material is used in order to eliminate noise turbidity caused by resonance of the enclosure, and a 33mm thick front baffle is used for the woofer part.It is equipped with a unique HP sound reflector to control standing waves inside the enclosure.The HP Sound Reflector provides low-frequency playback by uniformly attenuating the standing wave across all frequencies.Equipped with a bi-wireless speaker terminal.

sections.title: FOSTER-FOSTEX NF-1A
sections.overview: An active speaker system that pursues the concept of total monitoring by equipping the NF-1with an amplifier.The amplifier section has a simple circuit structure to achieve low distortion and low noise. Bi-AMP structure is used to drive each unit independently to eliminate noise pollution caused by electrical interference between units.A large R-core transformer is used in the power supply section to keep the operation of the power amplifier circuit in the optimum condition even under continuous load and to demonstrate the speaker performance even at high volume.A 16cm cone type woofer with FOSTEX-original HP (Hyperbolic Paraboloidal) diaphragm is mounted in the low range.The HP diaphragm has a third order phase structure consisting of a hyperbola and paraboloid, which eliminates the natural resonance that cannot be avoided with conventional diaphragms, and realizes high-speed original sound tracking with high structural strength. The HP diaphragm also realizes wide-range playback.The diaphragm is made of wood pulp as a base material combined with various new materials such as ultra-high modulus carbon fiber and super fiber PBO. By sublimating the characteristics of wood pulp to a higher dimension, we have achieved a fusion of propagation speed close to that of titanium and internal loss equal to that of PP material.In addition to the excellent linearity achieved by the push-pull double damper, the UDR tangential edge eliminates the inverse resonance that previously occurred at the edge, making it possible to reproduce without turbidity.A 2cm soft dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.This unit uses a UFLC diaphragm to achieve flat characteristics without peaks or dips and to eliminate unique characters.Each unit has an anti-magnetic design.The enclosure is designed with an emphasis on time alignment, and with a concentrated arrangement of woofer, tweeter, and bass reflex port, good phase characteristics and excellent localization reproduction capability are obtained.In addition, 21mmMDF material is used to suppress resonance of the enclosure. In particular, 33mm thick front baffle is used for the woofer to reduce vibration.Vibration control is applied between the amplifier and the enclosure rear, which tend to cause excessive resonance, and the power transformer is mounted to prevent vibration.Inside the enclosure is a unique HP sound reflector that attenuates standing waves uniformly across all frequencies, enabling efficient sound emission from the bass reflex port for superior speed and bass characteristics.It is equipped with a multi-function filter to adjust its characteristics according to the acoustic conditions that vary greatly depending on the location and installation method.In addition, the crossover frequency is set to 5kHz in order to ensure more efficient characteristic correction capability, the correction parameter is set to 3points of Lo Freq, Hi-Mid ATT, and Hi Freq, and the tweeter level is adjusted with a variable range of   3dB.It has XLR-type and phone-type input terminals.

description: Audio Database FOSTEX SLE20W ¥ 11,800 (1 piece, around 1972) ¥ 16,000 (1 piece, around 1976) Commentary Edgeless 20 cm cone type woofer unit. The edge is eliminated by the SLE (Super Long Lenear Excursion) employs an acoustic low-pass filter and a push-pull type damper. The part corresponding to the edge of the conventional speaker is a ring-shaped slit with a facing width of 1 mm and a depth of 28 mm. This slit forms an acoustic low-pass filter and has sufficient acoustic attenuation characteristics so that the sound from the back of the speaker does not leak through the slit in the audible band and the sound pressure does not decrease. Moreover, by eliminating the edge, problems such as amplitude distortion and treble caused by the edge, and frequency characteristic valley caused by reflection of the edge, which were caused by the conventional speaker at the time of amplitude, are solved. The vibrating part is supported by dampers symmetrically attached at two points of the voice coil. As a result, the asymmetry of the damper is canceled, the linearity is widened and the hysteresis phenomenon is reduced, and more accurate vibration is realized. In addition, the materials of the damper are also examined, and consideration is given so that the slit width does not change depending on the creep phenomenon even if it is used for a long time. SM (Synthetic Material) cone is used for the diaphragm, and division vibration is suppressed by having high rigidity and internal loss. The A-ring (Absorb Ring) and double dust cap structure improve the characteristics of the mid - and high-frequency range. The voice coil is treated with super-to withstand temperatures up to 230 ° C. The core paper is made of high-stiffness, flame-retardant epoxy mica resin. This voice coil is designed to withstand large input both in amplitude and electrical terms. sections.title: FOSTER-FOSTEX FT3RP
sections.overview: Planar tweeter unit using RP system.The RP method is a type of electroacoustic conversion method using a planar coil diaphragm. RP is an abbreviation of Regular Phase. It is a full-surface drive method in which the entire surface of the diaphragm moves in the same phase.The basic structure is such that an extremely thin high-density planar coil diaphragm is held by a special support system between a pair of magnetic circuits with the same poles facing each other, so that the entire diaphragm is driven uniformly. Since the mass of the vibration system is small and it is driven uniformly, the sound quality combines condenser type sound quality, electrokinetic type strength, and wide dynamic range.The advantages of the RP system include the ability to obtain high-pitched sound with flat characteristics and good elongation, extremely low distortion, good transient characteristics, good directional characteristics, high high-frequency reproduction limit, flat impedance characteristics, excellent input resistance, thin and lightweight units, and a wide range of applications, such as microphones and headphones, as well as skokers and tweeters.

Since the mass of the vibration system is small and it is driven uniformly, the sound quality combines condenser type sound quality, electrokinetic type strength, and wide dynamic range.The advantages of the RP system include the ability to obtain high-pitched sound with flat characteristics and good elongation, extremely low distortion, good transient characteristics, good directional characteristics, high high-frequency reproduction limit, flat impedance characteristics, excellent input resistance, thin and lightweight units, and a wide range of applications, such as microphones and headphones, as well as skokers and tweeters.

description: Audio Database FOSTEX SVA30 ¥ 44,000 (1 unit, around 1989) Commentary Active super woofer with built-in amplifier. The unit is equipped with a 30 cm cone type woofer using multi-layer cone. The magnetic circuit is designed with a repartion-type magnetic shielding design to eliminate adverse effects on cathode ray tubes, etc. Equipped with a low-pass filter that can switch the crossover frequency in three stages. The enclosure has a 45 cm square design and uses a bass reflex system. The woofer unit is mounted downward to minimize unwanted mid - and high-frequency radiation. Both the high-level (RCA pin) terminal and the low-level (speaker terminal) terminal are equipped with a pair of input and output terminals. These terminals can be connected even when the input / output terminal of the amplifier is insufficient.
